opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicant (and co-applicant if relevant) must be an RSC member (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently hold another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support. Undergraduate Student Members, Affiliates and Partner Scientists are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with a UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; submit in line with specified deadlines; and have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach projects that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines and a final deadline of 2 October 2026.
